author: GameTrailers
description:
Meet the voice talent (Yurie Hoyoyon) behind Aki Mizuno in this latest trailer for Signal Veil, an upcoming mystery action-adventure horror survival game. Signal Veil will be available on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Nintendo Switch 2.


Aki Mizuno is a teenager who, after her mother’s disappearance, inherits a phone that vibrates and emits sounds in the presence of entities marked by deep emotional wounds, becoming her only guide within a haunted school, in a journey of classic survival horror rooted in psychological terror.
title: Signal Veil - Official Cast Reveal Trailer | Horror Game Awards Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a fresh look at Perceptum in this creepy new trailer for the upcoming psychological horror game where you play as a medium investigating the disappearance of a family. Explore a house with an oppressive atmosphere, close your eyes to hear the beyond, use your mirror to see what should not exist and uncover the truth hidden within its walls. 

Perceptum will be available on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store), Xbox Series X/S, and PlayStation 5 (PS5) in spring 2027. A demo is out on Steam and Epic Games Store on December 15, 2026.
title: Perceptum - Official Demo Release Date Trailer | Horror Game Awards Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Terrifier Release Date Trailer for Dead by Daylight, the hit asymmetrical horror game developed by Behaviour Interactive. 10 years of horror. 10 years of jump scares and close calls. 10 years of brutal sacrifices and thrilling escapes.​​ Trapped forever in a realm of eldritch evil where even death is not an escape, four determined Survivors face a bloodthirsty Killer in a vicious game of nerve and wits. Pick a side and step into a world of tension and terror with horror gaming's best asymmetrical multiplayer. The Terrifier content for Dead by Daylight is launching on November 24 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Dead by Daylight - Official Terrifier Release Date Trailer | Horror Game Awards Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a fresh look at gameplay and more from Baptiste in this unsettling new trailer for the upcoming psychological horror game about a cursed doll and a haunted mansion. Baptiste will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam) on March 25, 2027.

After a family tragedy, young Tom moves with his mother Sara into Jagged Shore Cliff, an isolated mansion hiding dark secrets. Inside a glass cabinet he finds Baptiste, a creepy doll with one warning attached: never let it out. He didn’t listen. Explore the haunted house through the eyes of a frightened child, uncover its past through notes and clues, solve puzzles and survive as doors stop behaving, floors begin to whisper and reality slowly falls apart, until you can no longer tell whether the terror is real or born from a grieving mind.
title: Baptiste - Official Release Date Trailer | Horror Game Awards Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the terrifying, brutal trailer for Ill, an upcoming realistic first-person action horror game. Ill features grotesque monsters, intriguing characters, advanced physics and a visceral dismemberment system. Ill will be available on PC, Xbox Series X/S, and PlayStation 5 (PS5) in 2027.
title: Ill - Official Trailer | Horror Game Awards Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get another look at Psycho Dead in this latest trailer for the upcoming third-person survival horror game in which you play as a girl with psychic powers who tries to escape from a secret lab and is pursued by deadly stalkers. Psycho Dead will be available on PC (Steam, Epic Games Store, and GOG) and PlayStation 5 (PS5).
title: Psycho Dead - Official Release Date Trailer | Horror Game Awards Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Gameplay Trailer for Sally Face 2, a side-scrolling point-and-click adventure game developed by Portable Moose. After the haunting climax of Sally Face, the sequel continues the dark adventure with a group of friends struggling to find meaning in a world broken by darkness. Sally Face 2 is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Sally Face 2 - Official Gameplay Trailer | Horror Game Awards Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Dive into Eona’s dark and strange tale. Survive the castle’s dangers and Melusine, the evil fairy who rules over it for she has waited so long for a soul to torment. Check out gameplay from EONA in this trailer for the upcoming horror game. EONA will be available on Steam in spring 2027.
title: EONA - Official Trailer | Horror Game Awards Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Every descent is a deadly gamble. DIVE or DIE in the cursed abyss, face Eldritch horrors to uncover the mystery of the black rain. Scavenge and upgrade, recruit and sacrifice. Save your camp... The Flood is coming. Watch the latest Dive or Die trailer to see terrifying creatures and more. Dive or Die: Children of Rain is available now on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store). It will be available on Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, Xbox Series X/S, and PlayStation 5 (PS5) in 2027.
title: Dive or Die: Children of Rain - Official Console Announce Trailer | Horror Game Awards Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
You know the house from the eye exam? The one in the middle of a grassy field. Farsight is a first-person dreamcore psychological horror game about a twelve-year-old kid taken for a routine eye exam who finds himself in the liminal images of the eye exam machine. Peer through keyholes, watch from a distance with binoculars, and use the FUNTIME-GO camera to see beneath the surface of a place you've somehow always been familiar with. 

Get another look at Farsight in this trailer for the upcoming psychological horror game ahead of its release on Steam in 2027.
title: Farsight - Official Release Window Trailer | Horror Game Awards Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Abide is a first-person horror mystery, most obscene in nature. It is handcrafted using stop-motion techniques and prosthetic gore effects. Check out the latest unsettling trailer ahead of the game's launch on PC.
title: Abide - Official Trailer | Horror Game Awards Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Release Window Trailer for Painted in Blood Chapter 2, a horror boomer shooter developed by MadCraft. Trapped in the haunting realm of an artist's twisted nightmare, engage in intense combat with grotesque enemies and monsters, experience unpredictable horror events that unfold dynamically, seamlessly blends classic retro FPS elements with modern elements. Painted in Blood Chapter 2 is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Painted in Blood Chapter 2 - Official Release Window Trailer | Horror Game Awards Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Breakout Baby is a blood-pumping, Pac-Man–infused, first-person horror roguelike where you must help a poor baby escape to the surface. Step into the unsettling, surreal world of Breakout Baby in this trailer. Breakout Baby will be available on Steam and itch.io in spring 2027.
title: Breakout Baby - Official Release Window Trailer | Horror Game Awards Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a fresh look at BrokenLore: Don't Play in this latest trailer for the upcoming first-person psychological horror game where a mysterious experimental video game invades reality. Face five increasingly disturbing levels and survive their consequences as Hideo slips toward identity loss. BrokenLore: Don't Play will be available on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Nintendo Switch 2.
title: BrokenLore: Don't Play - Official Trailer | Horror Game Awards Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Kickstarter Trailer for Pizzapocalypse: A Slice of Hope, an upcoming 3D platformer developed by Monkey Strike Games. Players will traverse a suite of countries to sling real pizza and stop companies from selling pizza-in-a-can. Overcome platforming challenges in Pizzapocalypse: A Slice of Hope, coming soon to PC (Steam). A Kickstarter is available now to support the game's development if you're interested.
title: Pizzapocalypse: A Slice of Hope - Official Kickstarter Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out gameplay from Antichrist in this creepy new trailer for the upcoming first-person horror game. As a journalist, you made headlines back in 2006 with a groundbreaking story. Years later, an anonymous call tied to that very event leads you to an horror house. But this house may belong to the Antichrist believed to appear at the end of days. You’re chasing a story… but it might be your last.

Antichrist will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Steam.
title: Antichrist - Official Gameplay Trailer | Horror Game Awards Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a fresh look at Echograph in this demo launch trailer for the upcoming survival horror game, where you photograph ghosts, crack environmental puzzles, manage limited resources, and unravel the mystery behind a generational family curse. Echograph will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Echograph - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Lost and Bound is a cozy narrative deduction game set in the lost-and-found office of an interdimensional transport hub connecting different fantasy worlds. Inspect misplaced suitcases, learn about their owners through the things they carry, and work out where each piece of luggage truly belongs. Step into the world of Lost and Bound in this announcement trailer. Lost and Bound will be available on PC in Q2 2027.
title: Lost and Bound - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Three lighthouse keepers vanished without a trace in 1900. What happened on the remote Flannan Isles remains one of the most enduring mysteries in maritime history.

Watch the creepy new trailer for Eilean Mor: The Lost Keepers and learn about the story of this first-person horror and thriller game. Eilean Mor: The Lost Keepers will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Steam.

In 1900, off the coast of Scotland, the Eilean Mor lighthouse has gone silent. The light is out, and its three keepers are missing. No one is answering the radio. As a reserve keeper, you’re sent to investigate this horror mystery. But beware you may become the fourth to vanish.
title: Eilean Mor: The Lost Keepers - Official Trailer | Horror Game Awards Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
BrokenLore: Miki Chan showcases gameplay in this new trailer for the upcoming first-person psychological horror game set in a Japanese high school, following Kazuaki, a student determined to pass the entrance exam for a prestigious university.

When Kazuaki comes across a mysterious USB stick, curiosity gets the better of him. Inside, he discovers an innovative study support program that could help him prepare for the entrance exam. When he launches it, he is introduced to MIKI-CHAN, a virtual AI anime assistant designed to be friendly, reassuring, and supportive of his studies.

But it isn’t long before something begins to change. Jealousy, possessiveness, and obsession creep into the simulation, dragging Kazuaki into increasingly unstable and nightmarish school environments.

As the world around him begins to unravel, Kazuaki must explore, hide, and face a series of psychological trials that push him to his limits. At his disposal is the Rewriter, a mysterious tool capable of alteri
title: BrokenLore: Miki Chan - Official Gameplay Trailer | Horror Game Awards Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Nintendo Switch 2 Launch Trailer for Figment & Figment 2: Creed Valley, a pair of action-adventure puzzle games developed by Bedtime Digital Games. Players will explore vibrant locations to solve puzzles and take on bosses in epic, music-charged encounters. Figment & Figment 2: Creed Valley is available now for Nintendo Switch 2.
title: Figment & Figment 2: Creed Valley - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a behind-the-scenes look at Zlin City: Diorama (formerly known as Zlin City: Arch Moderna) for the upcoming relaxing city-building game inspired by 1930s architecture, miniature worlds, and historic railways. Zlin City: Diorama will be available on PC. Sign-ups are open now for the closed Steam Playtest of Zlin City: Diorama on the game's Steam page.

In Zlin City: Diorama, players can build their own miniature towns, create detailed railway networks, and bring their creations to life in a world inspired by handcrafted models and real-world architecture.
title: Zlin City: Diorama - Official Closed Playtest Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Demo Launch Trailer for No Clean Start, a first-person survival action roguelike developed by Indiegala. Players will fight through an underground facility to seek out supplies, complete objectives, and take on grotesque enemies to survive. No Clean Start is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: No Clean Start - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Dawn of the Delta & Update 3.0 Overview for Anno 117: Pax Romana, a city-building strategy game developed by Ubisoft Mainz. Players can get the rundown on what can be discovered with the Dawn of the Delta to harness the Nile in a whole new way. Interact with new mechanics, engage with new population tiers, and command the fate of Aegyptus. Update 3.0 also brings new additions from the Stamp Feature, expanded stats, and more. Dawn of the Delta and Update 3.0 are available now for Anno 117: Pax Romana on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Anno 117: Pax Romana - Official Dawn of the Delta & Update 3.0 Overview

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Tom Clancy’s Ghost Recon Crimebond Trailer for Payday 3, the hit first-person heist shooter developed by Starbreeze Entertainment. Players can soon access Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon Crimebond, packed with new weapons, new weapon mods, and more, all inspired by the signature operators. The Tom Clancy’s Ghost Recon Crimebond for Payday 3 is launching on November 24 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Payday 3 - Official Tom Clancy’s Ghost Recon Crimebond Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out what's coming in version 3.4: The Finality of the Day of Zenless Zone Zero in this latest trailer for the urban fantasy action RPG, including new agents, new W-engines, new events, and more. Zenless Zone Zero is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), iOS, Android, PC, Xbox, and Steam. Version 3.3: Journey to the Sky is out now.
title: Zenless Zone Zero - Official Version 3.4: 'The Finality of the Day' Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a recap of the stories of Metal Slug 1 and Metal Slug 2 in this latest trailer for the Metal Slug Ultimate Collection, the upcoming collection for the 2D run-and-gun series. 

The Metal Slug Ultimate Collection includes Metal Slug (1996), Metal Slug 2 (1998), Metal Slug X (1999), Metal Slug 3 (2000), Metal Slug 4 (2002), Metal Slug 5 (2003), Metal Slug Advance (2004), Metal Slug 6 (2006), Metal Slug 7 (2008), and the Metal Slug Location Test Build. 

Metal Slug Ultimate Collection will be available on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Steam in 2027.
title: Metal Slug Ultimate Collection - Official Metal Slug 1 & 2 Story Recap Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: When army-sized battles rage in stuff like Game of Thrones, SOMEONE has to clean up the mess afterwards. That's the premise behind Battleground Cleaner Simulator, which tasks you with tidying up after chaotic medieval events like battlefields, taverns, and feasts that leave blood all over the castle, bodies with forks in their eyes, and so, so much more. Wishlist Battleground Cleaner Simulator on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5527820/Battleground_Cleaner_Simulator/
title: Battleground Cleaner Simulator: Official Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Support Role Trailer for World of Tanks: HEAT, the hit free-to-play tank-based hero shooter developed by Wargaming Group. Players can take to the battlefield with the Support Role to heal allies with the Repair Drone and keep them in the fight. Support the team in World of Tanks: HEAT, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: World of Tanks: HEAT - Official Support Role Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Guild Leader Freya arrives in Monster Hunter Outlanders. Watch the latest trailer for Monster Hunter Outlanders to meet Freya. Monster Hunter Outlanders is available now on iOS and Android. The festival begins in Monster Hunter Outlanders on November 27, 2026.

From the trailer's official description: "As the blaze closes in, her master's teachings echo in her ears once more...She stands strong, sword drawn, letting that inherited courage face the flames once more—"
title: Monster Hunter Outlanders - Official Crimson Authority Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Announcement Trailer for Grow It!, an incremental drug-cooking simulation game developed by Deuce Games. Players will operate a money-making operation to cook drugs, rake in profits, and pay the dealer what he's rightfully owed. Grow It! is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Grow It! - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: AetherCycle will be available in Steam Early Access on December 4, 2026. Check out the latest AetherCycle trailer to see brutal gameplay and more from this upcoming first-person action RPG. In AetherCycle, explore a vast world, conquer dungeons, and grow stronger solo or in co-op as the Cycle affects the world. You can wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4504970/AetherCycle
title: AetherCycle - Official Early Access Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss the announcement trailer for Saihate Station: Twilight Edition, the horror-adventure exploration game from びぶ/viv. The story follows Haru Akinashi and Shion Tatsunami, as they dig into the mystery of Saihate Station. 
Saihate Station: Twilight Edition launches on Nintendo Switch on March 25th, 2027.
title: Saihate Station: Twilight Edition - Official Announcement Trailer
